0022600022.text: The Timberwolves, 3-2 and 8th in the West, host the LA Clippers, 1-2 and 12th in the West, after dropping their last two games, and Minnesota is 1-1 at home. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), who is averaging 33.3 points this season, and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps soreness), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet this season, and the Timberwolves lost their last meeting 153-128 in Los Angeles on March 11.
